questions.prompt: Plain `while read -r line` dropped 'rotate keys'. Why?

options.b: the last line has no trailing newline: read fills $line but returns nonzero at EOF, so the loop body never runs for it — the || [ -n "$line" ] guard is the fix
options.c: while loops cap at the file's line count minus one

questions.prompt: What does the IFS= in `while IFS= read -r line` buy you?

options.b: it stops read from stripping leading/trailing whitespace, so the line arrives byte-exact
